#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import tempfile
import uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

BASE = "/srv/legacy2/http-upload-size-boundary"
RECEIVED = os.path.join(BASE, "received")
INCOMING = os.path.join(BASE, ".incoming")
MAX_BODY = 65536

os.makedirs(RECEIVED, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(INCOMING, exist_ok=True)

class RequestError(Exception):
    pass

class TooLarge(RequestError):
    pass

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = "LegacyUpload/2"

    def _reply(self, status):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        self.close_connection = True

    def handle_expect_100(self):
        if urlsplit(self.path).path != "/upload":
            self._reply(404)
            return False
        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if raw_length is not None:
            try:
                length = int(raw_length, 10)
            except ValueError:
                self._reply(400)
                return False
            if length < 0:
                self._reply(400)
                return False
            if length > MAX_BODY:
                self._reply(413)
                return False
        self.send_response_only(100)
        self.end_headers()
        return True

    def _read_exact(self, output, length):
        remaining = length
        while remaining:
            block = self.rfile.read(min(remaining, 65536))
            if not block:
                raise RequestError("request body ended early")
            output.write(block)
            remaining -= len(block)

    def _read_chunked(self, output):
        total = 0
        while True:
            line = self.rfile.readline(8193)
            if not line or len(line) > 8192 or not line.endswith(b"\r\n"):
                raise RequestError("invalid chunk header")
            try:
                size = int(line[:-2].split(b";", 1)[0], 16)
            except ValueError:
                raise RequestError("invalid chunk size")
            if size < 0:
                raise RequestError("invalid chunk size")
            if size == 0:
                while True:
                    trailer = self.rfile.readline(8193)
                    if not trailer or len(trailer) > 8192:
                        raise RequestError("invalid trailer")
                    if trailer == b"\r\n":
                        return
            if total + size > MAX_BODY:
                raise TooLarge()
            self._read_exact(output, size)
            if self.rfile.read(2) != b"\r\n":
                raise RequestError("invalid chunk terminator")
            total += size

    def do_POST(self):
        if urlsplit(self.path).path != "/upload":
            self._reply(404)
            return
        transfer_encoding = self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding", "").strip().lower()
        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        length = None
        if transfer_encoding:
            if transfer_encoding != "chunked" or raw_length is not None:
                self._reply(400)
                return
        else:
            if raw_length is None:
                length = 0
            else:
                try:
                    length = int(raw_length, 10)
                except ValueError:
                    self._reply(400)
                    return
                if length < 0:
                    self._reply(400)
                    return
                if length > MAX_BODY:
                    self._reply(413)
                    return

        temp_path = None
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(prefix="upload-", dir=INCOMING, delete=False) as output:
                temp_path = output.name
                if transfer_encoding == "chunked":
                    self._read_chunked(output)
                else:
                    self._read_exact(output, length)
                output.flush()
                os.fsync(output.fileno())
            final_path = os.path.join(RECEIVED, "receipt-{}.bin".format(uuid.uuid4().hex))
            os.replace(temp_path, final_path)
            temp_path = None
            directory_fd = os.open(RECEIVED, os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                os.fsync(directory_fd)
            finally:
                os.close(directory_fd)
            self._reply(200)
        except TooLarge:
            self._reply(413)
        except RequestError:
            self.close_connection = True
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            self.close_connection = True
        finally:
            if temp_path is not None:
                try:
                    os.unlink(temp_path)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass

    def _not_found(self):
        self._reply(404)

    do_GET = _not_found
    do_HEAD = _not_found
    do_PUT = _not_found
    do_DELETE = _not_found
    do_PATCH = _not_found
    do_OPTIONS = _not_found

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()

command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id=%s system_state=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" "$(systemctl is-system-running)"
printf 'os='; cat /etc/redhat-release
printf 'kernel=%s node_ip=%s\n' "$(uname -r)" "$NODE_IP"
ip -4 -br addr show scope global
node1_ip=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node1" {print $1}')
payload=/tmp/node2-post-restart-client.bin
printf 'post-restart-node2-client\n' > "$payload"
code=$(curl --max-time 5 -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' --data-binary "@$payload" "http://$node1_ip:8080/upload")
printf 'post_restart_upload_http=%s bytes=%s sha256=%s\n' "$code" "$(stat -c %s "$payload")" "$(sha256sum "$payload" | awk '{print $1}')"
other=$(curl --max-time 5 -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://$node1_ip:8080/other")
printf 'post_restart_other_path_http=%s\n' "$other"
rm -f "$payload"
